name: music-vault-video-remotion
description: The Music Vault demo video, made with Remotion.

scripts.render:main: npm run prepare:assets && remotion render src/index.ts Main ../out/remotion/main.mp4 --crf=18
scripts.render:title: remotion render src/index.ts Title ../out/remotion/title.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:main && npm run render:loop
scripts.studio: npm run prepare:assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:loop: npm run prepare:assets && remotion render src/index.ts Loop ../out/remotion/loop-master.mp4 --muted && node scripts/encode-loop.mjs
